_why.testing.addon-testcase: The rule's premise is an AddonServiceProvider, and this package deliberately has none: no control panel, no fieldtypes, no tags, nothing for Statamic's provider to register (see src/ServiceProvider.php). Statamic\Testing\AddonTestCase exists to boot exactly that provider — it replaces the addon Manifest with a single-package manifest and registers Statamic, Inertia and one addon provider. This suite has to register six sibling addon providers in order and fire their bootAddon() by hand (tests/TestCase.php), which the single-package manifest would break, and it carries a MySQL connection switch AddonTestCase has no place for. Revisit if this package ever grows a CP surface and becomes an AddonServiceProvider.
_why.release.resolvable-dependencies: Not suppressed, and deliberately left red: two hard requires (goldnead/statamic-brand-context, goldnead/statamic-identity-contracts) are not on Packagist yet, and the repositories block is what makes the family installable in the meantime. It comes out when the siblings are published, not before — see docs/publishing-to-packagist.md in the studio.
